exposure: concern for COVID-19 transmission to the baby during pregnancy/birth
cohort: The study included 191 healthy pregnant women followed up in a gynaecological outpatient clinic during the late period of the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Healthy pregnant women experienced high levels of state (42.4%) and trait (64.4%) probable clinical anxiety during the late COVID-19 pandemic, with various socio-demographic, attitude-behavioural, and coping factors identified as predictors.
mod_finding: The fact that COVID-19 determined the preference of the birth method was found to predict state probable clinical anxiety.
cross-section timing: During their admissions to the gynaecological outpatient clinic in the late period of the COVID-19 pandemic.
